DuplicateRule.alertText: Possible duplicate — an account with a similar name already exists at this address. Check before saving: if this is the same household, update the existing account instead of creating a second one.
DuplicateRule.description: Ticket 2.2. Catches same-address household duplicates the phone rule misses (the Andrew J. Anderson pattern). Alert not Block: two accounts at one address can be legitimate. Report on, so matches reach Duplicate Record Sets.
